newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-GRAF WOMEN'S PLAYER OF YEAR FOR RECORD EIGHTH TIME.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF WOMEN'S PLAYER OF YEAR FOR RECORD EIGHTH TIME.

text.p: Steffi Graf was chosen the women's tennis player of the year for an unprecedented eighth time in voting by international media, the tour announced at the first-ever WTA TOUR/ATP Tour Awards Gala Wednesday.
It was the fourth consecutive year and eighth time in the last 10 years that Graf won the award. She had shared the record of seven with Martina Navratilova.
The German outpolled 16-year-old Martina Hingis of Switzerland, who won her first two career titles in 1996 and will take the number one ranking from Graf later this month.
Graf went 54-4 in 1996 and won seven titles, including the French Open, Wimbledon, the U.S. Open and the season-ending Chase Championships.
Graf also was selected by fans as the most exciting player in balloting conducted at several tournaments in the late summer and on the Tour's website in late 1996.
Following are the 1996 WTA Tour Award finalists and winners:
Player of the Year Finalists: Martina Hingis and Steffi Graf Winner: Graf
Doubles team of the year Finalists: Martina Hingis/Helena Sukova, Lindsay Davenport/Mary Joe Fernandez, Jana Novotna/Arantxa Sanchez Vicario Winner: Novotna/Sanchez Vicario
Most improved player of the year Finalists: Irina Spirlea, Karina Habsudova, Martina Hingis Winner: Hingis
Most impressive newcomer of the year Finalists: Patty Schnyder, Henrieta Nagyova, Anna Kournikova Winner: Kournikova
Comeback player of the year Finalists: Meredith McGrath, Barbara Paulus, Jennifer Capriati Winner: Capriati
Karen Krantzcke sportsmanship award (voted by players) Finalists: Sabine Appelmans, Amy Frazier, Yayuk Basuki Winner: Basuki
Player service award (voted by players) Finalists: Mariaan de Swardt, Marianne Werdel Witmeyer, Katrina Adams Winner: Adams
Diamond aces award (voted by tournaments) Finalists: Gabriela Sabatini, Arantxa Sanchez Vicario, Monica Seles Winner: Sabatini
David Gray service award (awarded by the Tour) Winner: Martina Navratilova
Ted Tinling media person of the year Mary Carillo
